Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning property assessments and the appeal of those assessments.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to property assessments and the appeal of thoseassessments; and adding a new section to chapter 84.40 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 84.40 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: If an owner or person responsible for payment of taxes on anyproperty that has been valued in excess of five hundred thousanddollars seeks to appeal the valuation pursuant to RCW 84.40.038, theowner or person responsible for payment of taxes must be provided witha notice of valuation signed by a licensed certified appraiser. Thenotice must include the contact information for the appraiser whosigned the notice of valuation and a description of the process forappealing the valuation.
